scope: Historical Mosaic and Dial validation only. Relay scoring is changed; no equivalence claimed. New policy run hashes use actual integrated bytes.

files.review: Reviewed service-only changes and exact observation-profile initialization/camera-size reporting transformations. The remaining AST matches the original unchanged digest, including World stepping, controls, task sampling and motion recording. This is historical physical-source compatibility, not policy/image/scoring equivalence or new physics qualification. Re-reviewed for the single-arm recovery entry World.recover_action, which only reads and ends an action whose timed-out stop is already uncertain; it is admitted by exact AST match and the remaining AST still matches the original digest. Re-reviewed for run storage and segments: the portable saved scene, the motion rate and process-log format read from the frozen harness, segment folders, the segment restore and held-grasp snapshot, and the engineering fault entry are exact reviewed statements that act only for new runs that freeze those settings or continue in a new segment (source_compatibility.WORLD_RUN_STORAGE); with them reverted the AST equals the original unaffected digest.

Re-reviewed for the Mosaic Level 2/3 centre tolerance: mosaic_candidates reads xy_center_tolerance_m_inclusive from the task with the original 5 mm default, so tasks without mosaic-center-6mm-v1 are unchanged (source_compatibility.MOSAIC_CENTER_TOLERANCE). The Relay class stays excluded; its 70 percent rule is a new scoring contract, not claimed equal to the old one.

Only the exact reviewed Controller/Coordinator label acceptance and engine/direct-START selection checks in load_harness are normalized. All remaining AST nodes match the pinned baseline, including action limits, controller settings and execution timing. This is historical control-source compatibility, not equal physics, policy observations or current-task qualification. Re-reviewed for the two new frozen harness checks in load_harness (motion_hz, process_log), which only validate new settings (source_compatibility.HARNESS_RUN_STORAGE); with them removed the AST equals the original unaffected digest.

files.scope: Reviewed English captions only; draw geometry, inputs and runtime behavior unchanged

files.review: Only the exact reviewed PandaArm statements for local recovery of an uncertain stop (recover_stopped and its stability sampling after uncertainty) and the engineering fault hold are normalized (source_compatibility.ARM_RECOVERY). This is historical control-source compatibility, not new physics qualification.
